Amiga_enhanced_games_2026-11-14.hdf  (33554432 bytes, bare FFS hardfile, md5 below)
built by tools/make_amiga_hd.py from the current patched builds

Volume "Games" (mounted by FS-UAE as DH0, bootable, DOS\1 FFS, 32 MiB).
The image BOOTS TO THE WORKBENCH DESKTOP: open the Games volume and double-click
mwII (it has a tool icon), or from a Shell: CD Games:  then  mwII.
  C Libs Devs S System Utilities Prefs Classes Expansion WBStartup Fonts T RexXC
      Workbench 3.1 (from os/WorkBench/amiga-os-310-workbench.adf)
  mwII progdir midword.fsd cods.bin grafix/ grafdir missions/ missdir
      Midwinter II, PATCHED (direct controls). The game only runs from the
      volume root - this is exactly what its own DH0 installer produces.
  ORIG/mwII+data
      the unpatched executable, for comparison (copy to the root as mwII to run)
  S/User-Startup
      comments only - the desktop is left to the user
  README.txt

Use
  FS-UAE:      dist/run_hd.sh
  real Amiga:  write the image to an SD/CF card or a .hdf-aware device, or mount
               the volume contents on any partition (files must sit in the root)
  Gotek-style floppy emulators cannot hold a hard disk image
e94fae2234f92f4e52e429e157ccdada  dist/Amiga_enhanced_games_2026-11-14.hdf

Boot test (FS-UAE A1200, KS 3.1, no floppies, hard_drive_0 = this image)
  hallway     666090c5c090558510ee8317c654e01c
  level pick  7d4a634d95f7bb6dad7ea072aee0d9fa
  raid map    7816fe1d04bee4ebf78bbb6419492e97
  cockpit     aaaf2da438becd2b5fc64073a7111439
  (played through with the same held-press menu sequence as the floppy build)

Rebuild order
  python3 tools/mw2patch.py apply  <MWII from d1>  games/in_progress/Midwinter-2/work/build/MWII_direct
  python3 tools/make_amiga_hd.py            -> this .hdf
  python3 tools/make_amiga_zip.py           -> Midwinter2-Amiga-hd-<date>.zip
